title: New post
intro: Describe the topic and what data to use. The connector creates an empty draft in Ghost and plans it: you'll watch the text being written live and review it before anything else is written.

topic.label: Topic
topic.hint: What the post should cover, in a sentence or two.
topic.placeholder: e.g. How to grow vegetables on a small balcony

postTitle.label: Title
postTitle.hint: Leave it empty to use the topic. The writer may suggest a better one.

sources.label: Sources and data
sources.hint: Links, figures or notes to use. Links are read before writing: a website, a repo or a GitHub organization (its most-starred repos).

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.hint: Tone, length, angle, sections you want…

steps.title: What happens next
steps.create: An empty draft is created on {url} (the only thing written to Ghost now).
steps.read: Any links you added are read.
steps.write: The writer drafts the post. Meanwhile, SEO and image candidates are prepared.
steps.review: You review, answer its questions, pick the image and apply. Nothing is ever published.
steps.note: It never invents quotes or interviews with real people: if you ask for them without providing the answers, it leaves the questions ready for you.
